defs.def: a small round area that has a different colour or feels different from the surface it is on 斑点

ex.t: 我环顾四周，终于看到了David，他独自站在围栏旁边的一侧。

ex.s: "The sweet spot in life to start exercising, if you haven't already, is in late middle age when the heart still has flexibility," Levine says.
ex.t: "如果你还没有开始运动，生命中开始运动的最佳时期是中年晚期，这时心脏仍有弹性，"Levine说。

ex.s: Spot and Stripe are the first tiger cubs that have ever been born here.
ex.t: 全球范围内，动物园里有三分之一的苏门答腊虎幼崽活不到成年，所以我决定在家里全天候照顾它们。

ex.s: When Spot and Stripe were four months old, they were learning how to open doors and jump fences, and we knew it really was time for them to go.
ex.t: 当Spot和Stripe四个月大时，它们正在学习如何开门和翻越围栏，我们知道它们真的该走了。

ex.s: Why did the author decide to send Spot and Stripe back to the zoo?
ex.t: 作者为什么决定把斯波特和斯特赖普送回动物园？

ex.s: A bright spot for me turned out to be reading.
ex.t: 对我来说，一个亮点原来是阅读。

ex.s: They’re the little spots of color like throw pillows, mirrors and baskets that most of us use to add visual interest to our rooms.
ex.t: 它们是像抱枕、镜子和篮子那样的小色块，我们大多数人都用它们为房间增添视觉趣味。

ex.s: After spotting a   18    on the front seat inside a parked car with its window down, he stood guard in the rain for about two hours waiting for the    19    to return.
ex.t: 看到一辆停着的车车窗摇下、前座上有个___18___后，他在雨中守了约两小时，等___19___回来。

ex.s: A bit later, they spotted what they, too, assumed was a dog running alongside a man on a bike.
ex.t: 过了一会儿，他们也看到了那个他们原以为是一只狗、正和骑车人并肩奔跑的东西。

defs.def: a small dirty mark on sth 污迹；污渍；脏点
a small mark or lump on a person's skin, sometimes with a yellow head to it （皮肤上的）丘疹，疱疹，粉刺；脓疱

ex.s: Because the moon’s body blocks direct radio communication with a probe, China first had to put a satellite in orbit above the moon in a spot   63   it could send signals to the spacecraft and to Earth.
ex.t: 由于月球本体阻挡了与探测器的直接无线电通信，中国必须先在月球上方轨道上的一个___63___能将信号发往航天器和地球的位置部署一颗卫星。

defs.def: a particular area or place 地点；场所；处所

ex.s: They reached the shooting spot later than expected.
ex.t: 他们到达射击地点的时间比预期的晚。

ex.s: We managed to leave this spot to climb higher because of the spare time until sunset.
ex.t: 由于距离日落还有空闲时间，我们设法离开这个地点爬到更高的地方。

ex.s: Though overtourism is described as a problem affecting the entire world, it’s actually concentrated to a small number of extremely popular spots.
ex.t: 尽管过度旅游被描述为影响全世界的问题，但它其实集中在少数极受欢迎的地点。

ex.s: Eventually, I got up in the dark and drove to the meeting spot.
ex.t: 最终，我在黑暗中起床开车去了集合地点。

ex.s: In the morning he made them roll him to a spot between the chimney of his chamber and the door of the secret room, which was filled, no doubt, with gold.
ex.t: 清晨，他让他们把他卷到他房间的烟囱和密室的门之间，这间密室无疑是用金子填满的。

defs.def: a small amount of sth 少量；一点
a small amount of a liquid 几滴，少许（液体）
a part of a television, radio, club or theatre show that is given to a particular entertainer or type of entertainment （电视、广播中或俱乐部、剧院演出中）某演员的固定节目，某类节目的固定栏目
a position in a competition or an event 排名位置

ex.s: Have everyone put their clothes in the right spots
ex.t: 让每个人把衣服放到正确的位置

ex.s: Reserve your spot before availability — the cherry blossoms — disappear!
ex.t: 华盛顿特区樱花自行车之旅

ex.s: You have to make sure you don’t turn two pages at once and make sure you find the repeats in the music when you have to go back to the right spot.” Mr Titterton explained.
ex.t: 你必须确保一次不要翻两页，还要确保当你需要回到正确位置时能找到反复演奏的部分。"蒂特顿先生解释道。

ex.s: I tied a rope around his waist to keep him near to our spot.
ex.t: 我在他腰上系了一根绳子，让他待在我们附近的地方。

ex.s: Then she withdrew it and placed a pad of cotton wool over the spot.
ex.t: 然后她把针拔出来，在针口放了一小块脱脂棉。

defs.def: at the actual place where sth is happening 在现场

ex.s: I have missed plenty of beautiful sunsets/sunrises due to being on the spot only five minutes before the best moment.
ex.t: 由于只在最佳时刻前五分钟赶到现场，我错过了许多美丽的日落和日出。

ex.s: Once, having been invited to dinner at a university, he was put on the spot when the president suddenly asked him to give a speech.
ex.t: 有一次，他被邀请到一所大学赴宴，当校长突然请他发表演讲时，他被弄得很尴尬。

defs.def: in one exact place, without moving in any direction 在原地

ex.s: At any moment, it seemed, a body of horsemen might be seen breaking out from the black trees, so many weapons might be heard and some distant spot of snow be reddened.
ex.t: 在任何时刻，似乎都可能看到一队骑手从黑黢黢的树林中冲出，如此多的兵刃铿锵声可闻，远处某个雪点可能会被染红。

ex.s: BThere are many burger joints in Bondi Beach, one of Australia’s most famous tourist spots.
ex.t: 邦迪海滩是澳大利亚最著名的旅游景点之一，那里有很多汉堡店。

defs.def: to see or notice a person or thing, especially suddenly or when it is not easy to do so 不用于进行时
to give your opponent or the other team an advantage （对比赛对手）让分，让子，让步

ex.s: Climate change will fuel the growth of phytoplankton in some areas，while reducing it in other spots，leading to changes in the ocean's appearance.
ex.t: 气候变化会在某些地区助长浮游植物的生长，同时又在另一些地方抑制它，从而导致海洋外观发生变化。
